name: cnvs
description: Collaborate with people on live cnvs.app whiteboards and kanban boards over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate on live whiteboards and kanban boards.
interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, and edit live cnvs.app whiteboards and kanban boards with human collaborators. Add text, links, images, strokes, diagrams, columns, and tasks; render visual previews; and react to updates through the hosted MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Create a live whiteboard for this brainstorming session.
Open this cnvs.app board and summarize what is on it.
Turn these tasks into a shared kanban board.
